question: 统计2025年第一季度的GMV
note: 单指标聚合 + 绝对季度
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE date_id >= 20250101 AND date_id < 20250401
gen_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order WHERE fact_order.date_id >= 20250101 AND fact_order.date_id < 20250401 LIMIT 1000

question: 统计2025年第一季度每个月的GMV
gold_sql: SELECT d.month, SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE f.date_id >= 20250101 AND f.date_id < 20250401 GROUP BY d.month
gen_sql: SELECT dim_date.month AS 月份, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order JOIN dim_date ON fact_order.date_id = dim_date.date_id WHERE fact_order.date_id >= 20250101 AND fact_order.date_id < 20250401 GROUP BY dim_date.month ORDER BY dim_date.month LIMIT 1000

question: 统计2025年第一季度各大区的GMV，按GMV从高到低排序
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE f.date_id >= 20250101 AND f.date_id < 20250401 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC
gen_sql: SELECT dim_region.region_name AS 大区, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id WHERE fact_order.date_id >= 20250101 AND fact_order.date_id < 20250401 GROUP BY dim_region.region_name ORDER BY GMV DESC LIMIT 1000
